[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
McKenzie Glasgow was baptised at North Leith on 17 December 1734. The companion derivatives name William Glasgow and Jean Love as his parents. [[Glasgow-3408|William Glasgow]] is a possible identification of the named father, assessed at 59%; [[Love-11868|Jane Love]] remains the separately unassessed maternal attribution. His exact birth day is not recorded.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686222678&tab=this Findmypast baptism derivative R_686222678] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691921324&tab=this companion R_691921324], McKenzie Glasgow, North Leith, 17 December 1734; inspected 30 October 2026, originals uninspected.</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Parish-register evidence ===
The two North Leith derivatives record Mckenzie Glasgow, male, baptised on 17 December 1734, with parents William Glasgow and Jean Love. Jean is the literal indexed maternal name; identification with [[Love-11868|Jane Love]] remains a separate question. Identification of the named father with [[Glasgow-3408|William Glasgow]], born at Irvine, remains possible at 59%; neither derivative supplies an occupation, origin or migration bridge. Both may derive from the same entry.

A separate Ayr derivative records the baptism of Mckenzie Glasgow on 18 July 1754, with father also indexed as Mckenzie Glasgow and mother Margaret Davidson. The 1734 child could chronologically be this named father, but no marriage or Leith-to-Ayr continuity establishes that identity. The repeated given name needs checking against the original. The 1754 baptism concerns the child in that entry, not a second baptism assigned to the 1734 child.
